data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate Broker LLC – Business Bay Branch proudly presents this beautifully upgraded and fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment in The Residences 11, District One, one of Dubai's most prestigious waterfront communities.

Offered for AED 160,000 per annum, this exceptional residence combines contemporary elegance with everyday comfort. Meticulously upgraded throughout, the apartment features premium finishes, designer furnishings, and a thoughtfully planned layout with 3 bathrooms, providing both comfort and convenience for modern living.

Situated within the only building in The Residences that offers both a swimming pool and a fully equipped gym, this apartment is among the most desirable homes in the community. Fully furnished and ready for immediate occupancy, it presents an outstanding opportunity for tenants seeking a turnkey residence in a prime waterfront location.

Property Features:

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Fully Upgraded Interior
Fully Furnished
Panoramic Crystal Lagoon Views
Built-In Kitchen Appliances
Spacious Balcony
Built-In Wardrobes
Bright & Spacious Living and Dining Area
Premium Finishes Throughout
Ready to Move In
Rental Price: AED 160,000 per annum

Building Amenities:

Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Gym
24/7 Security & CCTV
Grand Lobby
Dedicated Covered Parking

Location Highlights:

11 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
22 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
24 Minutes to Dubai Marina

District One is renowned for its iconic crystal lagoon, lush landscaped surroundings, and exceptional lifestyle amenities, offering residents the perfect balance of luxury, privacy, and connectivity. Ideally located in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, this remarkable residence provides an exclusive waterfront living experience just minutes from Dubai's major business and leisure destinations.
